title: Ordination Docket Rank Correction Request
resolutionSummary: Under active examination by Secretary General

messages.message: Greetings in the Holy Order. We noticed candidate Peter Chima Tester's docket indicates Target Rank as 'Aladura' instead of 'Senior Apostle' in line with his 14 years of active pastoral service at the Cathedral. Kindly update the vetting docket before Synod council clears the list.

Peace be unto you Elder. We have retrieved the physical recommendation letter from Ebute Metta District and forwarded it to the Ecclesiastical Vetting Board for docket alignment. We will update the status once ratified.
Your inquiry is being evaluated by the Synod Council.
